text: You have not said her name aloud in three months, and tonight the phone will say it for you.
picture: The Storyteller stands in the center of the frame, a tall, slender silhouette against pure black. The lantern is held at chest height, its red flame casting a soft, downward glow that illuminates the stick figure's hands and the lower part of its face. The lantern sways gently.
motion: The lantern sways slightly, the red flame flickering.

text: The lantern is lit. Some calls come from places that have been dark for a long time.
picture: Close-up on the Storyteller's lantern. The red flame fills the frame, its light revealing the texture of the chalk lines. The surrounding blackness is absolute.
motion: The red flame flickers and dances.

text: Wherever a line runs between places, there is a hollow beside it.
picture: An abstract, empty black frame. A single, clean white line appears, drawing itself from the left to right, creating a road.
motion: The white line draws itself from left to right.

text: A road, a railway, a phone line.
picture: Insert shot. The white line of 'road' is now seen from a low angle. Beside it, a faint negative space in the shape of a hollow human figure is quickly etched into the black and then fades, leaving only the line.
motion: The hollow shape etches itself and fades.

text: Most people pass through without noticing. Some don't.
picture: Three parallel white lines now stretch across the frame: a road, a railway, a phone line. A subtle, ghostly hollow shape is beside each, barely visible before disappearing. Danger lies to the right of the frame.
motion: The hollow shapes shimmer faintly and vanish.

text: The phone shows 2:47 AM. You are Leo.
picture: Leo sits slumped at a messy break room table, shoulders hunched. The green dinosaur is clenched in his hand. On the table, a digital phone shows 2:47 AM in red numbers. Mira stands to his right, looking at a paper in his hands.
motion: Leo's thumb slowly rubs the back of the dinosaur.
sound: the low hum of fluorescent lights

text: You are rolling a green plastic dinosaur between
picture: Close-up on Leo's hands on the table. His right hand rolls the green plastic dinosaur between thumb and forefinger in a repetitive, anxious motion.
motion: The dinosaur rolls back and forth in his fingers.

text: your fingers, showing Mira, your trainee, the extension list.
picture: Wider from Leo's left side. He holds the extension list on the table with one hand, pointing to it with the dinosaur. Mira leans in from his right, her face attentive. The red-accent phone is on a shelf behind them, its message light dark.
motion: Leo's dinosaur-hand taps the list.

text: The list hasn't been updated since February. You point to the dash where a name should be. Extension seven.
picture: Close-up on the paper list. Leo's finger (not the dinosaur) points to a line that reads 'Extension 7: ----.'. The dash is stark and blank. The paper is creased and worn.
motion: A finger points steadily at the dash.

text: You tell her what you were told: that line rings
picture: Leo looks up at Mira, his face neutral but his eyes tired and focused elsewhere. He speaks, but his mouth is a simple line. The dinosaur rests on the table near his hand.
motion: Leo's head turns slightly toward Mira.

text: into a floor that's been dark since the electrical fire.
picture: Close-up on Leo's face from a three-quarter angle. His gaze is not on Mira but past her, into the middle distance. The shadows under his eyes are pronounced.
motion: His eyes remain fixed, unblinking.

text: You do not tell her you have memorized this minute. You do not tell her why you volunteered for nights.
picture: Wide shot of the break room from behind Leo. He is a small, hunched figure at the table. Mira stands beside him, looking concerned. The window shows a dark night outside. A phone sits on a distant counter. Space is to the left - the safe direction.
motion: A faint reflection of Leo's hunched form is seen in the dark window.

text: You want to finish this shift. Hand Mira to day staff.
picture: Extreme close-up on Leo's face, eyes closed. His cheek is slack, his brow lightly furrowed in concentration. Superimposed over his cheekbone, a small, simple white chalk outline of a car proceeds left-to-right along a rain-streaked road toward a dark house in the distance.
motion: The superimposed car moves steadily left-to-right.

text: Drive to the hospice house where you promised Ana you'd be there when she wakes.
picture: Leo still stands, eyes closed. The image of the car and road now fills the space beside him, larger, the dark house more distinct. Visible in the house's window is a faint, warm glow from within. Leo's shoulders are set with determination.
motion: Rain streaks down vertically over the road illustration.

text: She is eight months pregnant.
picture: A simple, tender image filling the black page: Ana, facing slightly away, her hand resting on her pregnant belly. Her face is gentle but carries a trace of melancholy. She stands in a soft, undefined space of memory.
motion: Ana's hand strokes her belly once.

text: The baby arrives in two weeks, when your paternity leave starts.
picture: Insert shot of a simple calendar page. The month and days are ghostly white outlines. A red circle, the only color besides the accent, is drawn around a date two weeks in the future. A tiny chalk dinosaur is sketched next to it.
motion: The camera pushes in slowly on the red-circled date.

text: You say 'sim' when you mean yes. You call trainees 'querida' without noticing.
picture: Leo, hunched, presses a button on a stark white coffee machine. A stream of hot water pours into his plain white cup. His other hand is in his pocket, clutching the dinosaur.
motion: The hot water stream pours.

text: The coffee machine offers two buttons that work: sterk and thee water.
picture: Insert shot of the coffee machine's front panel. Only two of the many buttons are solid white: 'sterk' and 'thee water'. The others are ghostly, non-functional outlines.
motion: A drop of water condenses and drips from the spout.

text: You take thee water with three sugars.
picture: Medium shot of Leo from behind, his head bowed. He holds the cup and methodically taps three sugar packets against its rim before tearing them open. The sugar cascades in.
motion: The sugar crystals fall into the water.

text: A habit from São Paulo night shifts, back when you worked pediatric
picture: A flash of memory: a younger Leo, back straight but eyes hollow, sits at a brightly lit desk cluttered with monitors and papers. The setting is a hectic, ghostly open-plan office.
motion: Younger Leo's hand swipes tiredly across his face.

text: ICU, back before you burned out and crossed an ocean for something quieter.
picture: The memory dissolves into a simple, distant overhead shot of a tiny chalk airplane moving left-to-right over a vast, black ocean. The figure of Leo is silhouetted inside, head against the window.
motion: The airplane moves left-to-right across the empty black.

text: Mira notices the dinosaur in your hand. She smiles.
picture: Close-up on Leo's hand rolling the green dinosaur between thumb and forefinger. On the shiny plastic surface, a distorted, smiling reflection of Mira's face looks back.
motion: The dinosaur rotates slowly.

text: 'Yours?' she asks. You almost tell her about the baby. You do not.
picture: Leo and Mira face each other across the break room table. Leo looks down at his hand, his mouth slightly open as if to speak, then closes it. Mira leans forward slightly, her expression open and encouraging.
motion: Leo's jaw tightens as he swallows his words.

text: Mira takes her first solo call. You watch from the break room, your extension 704,
picture: Leo sits at his desk 704, looking through a large window. Outside the window, we see the main call floor. In the depth of the shot, distant and small, Mira sits at her desk with a headset on. A fire exit stairwell door is prominent in the background, far right.
motion: Mira, far away, nods as she listens.

text: the only desk with a window facing the stairwell.
picture: Insert shot through the window, showing the metal push-bar of the distant stairwell door. A small, white 'EXIT' sign glows above it.
motion: A reflection of overhead lights glints on the metal bar.

text: You chose it for the view of the exit.
picture: Back to Leo at his desk, the green dinosaur resting beside his keyboard. His gaze is fixed on the distant exit door, not on Mira. His posture is tense, ready. On his desk phone, the message light is off.
motion: Leo's eyes track slowly from Mira towards the exit door.

text: A kettle starts. Low and building.
picture: Leo sits at his cubicle, staring at the phone in his hand. His slumped shoulders are tensed. His tired eyes look at the bright screen, which shows the time: 2:47. The kettle sound begins faintly.
motion: The phone screen's digits glow steadily.

text: From nowhere in the building. You check your phone.
picture: From a high angle, we see Leo's cubicle island in the dark office floor. He is a small, hunched figure. Empty desks and dark monitors stretch into the background. The sound seems to come from the void.
motion: Leo slowly turns his head, looking around the empty office.

text: 2:47. It hasn't changed.
picture: Extreme close-up on Leo's face. His eyes are wide, his brow furrowed in confusion. He is looking down at the phone in his hand. The green dinosaur is barely visible in his other hand, clutched tight.
motion: His eyes dart from the phone to the darkness beyond.

text: The red light on extension 704 blinks. It has been blinking since February.
picture: A tight shot of the phone on desk 704. The tiny red message light on the handset blinks rhythmically. It is the only color, a bright pulse against the black phone and the dark desk.
motion: The red light blinks steadily, ominously.

text: You see it reflected in Mira's worried eyes before you see it yourself.
picture: The shot is entirely the surface of Mira's eye. Reflected in her pupil, perfectly clear, is the tiny, blinking red light of the phone. Her eye is wide with worry. It is the ONLY red in the entire frame.
motion: The reflection of the red light pulses in her eye.

text: The carrier hum from Floor 7 seeps through the
picture: Wide shot of desk 704 from a low angle. The blinking red phone is in the foreground. In the background, high on the dark wall, a vent grille is visible. A deep, unnatural hum seems to emanate from it.
motion: The red light pulses. A faint, rhythmic distortion shimmers the air near the vent.

text: vents, a tone that shouldn't exist on disconnected fiber.
picture: Close-up on the vent grille. It is a black rectangle of slats. Beyond the slats is only darkness. The hum is almost a visible vibration.
motion: The hum grows slightly, making the chalk lines of the vent seem to waver.

text: The kettle builds. And the red light keeps blinking, patient, as if it
picture: Back to the phone on desk 704. The red light blinks. The kettle sound builds in the background, a whistle starting to form. The light's pulse feels synchronized with the building sound.
motion: The red light blinks. Each blink seems to push the kettle whistle higher.

text: has been waiting for you to finally look at it.
picture: Leo stands a few feet from desk 704, looking at the blinking phone. His body is rigid. His gaze is locked on the red light. His shadow, cast by a distant monitor's glow, stretches long towards the phone.
motion: He does not move. The light blinks, patient.

text: Extension seven rings. Mira freezes, hand hovering over the headset.
picture: From behind Mira, we see the entire cubicle bay. Mira stands frozen at her desk, one hand outstretched, hovering over her headset. Desk 704 is in the foreground, its red light blinking. The space feels vast and empty.
motion: Mira is perfectly still. The red light blinks.

text: The kettle sound builds somewhere below, a whistle starting to crack.
picture: Close-up on Mira's face. Her eyes are wide with fear, staring at the headset. Her mouth is slightly open. The kettle whistle cracks sharply in the background.
motion: A tiny tremble runs through her outstretched hand.

text: You cannot let a call go unanswered.
picture: Over Mira's frozen shoulder, we see Leo's hand enter the frame from the right. It moves past her hovering hand with purpose, reaching for the headset on desk 704.
motion: Leo's hand moves decisively across the frame, left to right.

text: Years in pediatric ICU wired this into your hands before your brain can catch up.
picture: Extreme close-up on the blinking red phone and the headset cradle. Leo's fingers enter the frame and close around the headset. The green dinosaur is tucked between his fingers.
motion: His fingers tighten on the headset, lifting it.

text: You reach past her. You answer.
picture: Close-up on Leo's face in profile as he brings the headset to his ear. His eyes are shut tight, his jaw clenched. The red light of the phone casts a faint glow on the side of his face.
motion: He places the headset against his ear. A beat.

text: The voice is Ana's.
picture: Leo is in profile at his cubicle, frozen, holding the headset to his ear. His back is to us, slightly hunched, his free hand unmoving on the desk. The faint, ghostly silhouette of Ana is just behind his left shoulder, a transparent chalk outline looking toward him. The only red is the blinking light on the phone reflected in his wide eye.
motion: His chest stops moving, holding a breath.

text: Clear and close, as if she is standing at your shoulder.
picture: Extreme close-up on Leo's face in three-quarter view. His eyes are wet and wide, staring at nothing. Ana's faint silhouette is now just a suggestion of hair and a shoulder, blurred at the very edge of the frame on the left, as if whispering into his ear.
motion: His pupils dilate slightly.

text: She says your name. The whole thing. Leonardo.
picture: A tight insert shot of Leo's ear and the plastic headset receiver pressed against it. The ghostly silhouette of Ana's lips are drawn faintly, impossibly close to the receiver's holes.
motion: A single wisp of chalk-white breath, Ana's, curls from the headset's mesh.

text: She only uses that when she is worried. She says she made caldo verde.
picture: Leo at his desk, eyes now closed, face tilted upward as if smelling something. His body is less rigid. Wispy, curling chalk lines rise from the headset he still holds, suggesting steam.
motion: His nostrils flare with a slow, deep inhale.

text: You have never learned to make caldo verde.
picture: Close on Leo's face, eyes still closed. A faint grimace of pain or longing touches his mouth. The wispy steam lines now form vague shapes above his head—a kettle, a pot.
motion: His throat moves as he swallows hard.

text: But you smell it now through the receiver. Kale.
picture: An abstract insert. The black shot is filled with swirling, ghostly chalk-white lines that form a kale leaf, then dissolve into cubed potatoes.
motion: The shapes morph and fade into one another.

text: Potato. The chouriço her mother sends from Porto.
picture: Wide shot of Leo alone at his desk in the dark call center. He is a small, hunched figure. More abstract scent-lines now form a coil of chouriço above him, before the entire plume of 'scent' violently disperses. The phone with its blinking red light is prominent on the desk.
motion: The white lines shatter into nothing.

text: The kettle clicks off. Silence.
picture: Back to a close-up on Leo's face. His eyes are open now, staring directly ahead, utterly blank. A single chalk line, a tear, starts at the corner of his eye.
motion: The tear begins its slow track down his cheek.

text: Then Ana says: 'I'll be there when you wake.'
picture: Leo's face crumples. He brings his free hand up to cover his mouth, his shoulders shaking. The tear is now halfway down his cheek. The red message light blurs in his watery vision.
motion: A tremor runs through his hand over his mouth.

text: You asked her that once, before the diagnosis, before the hospice bed.
picture: A fleeting memory insert: A simple, faint chalk drawing superimposed over Leo's anguished face. It shows Leo and Ana in bed, Ana sleeping, her pregnant belly a curve under the sheets. Leo is turned toward her, his mouth open in a whisper.
motion: The memory image flickers and vanishes.

text: You said it to her each night while she slept, eight months pregnant, the baby kicking.
picture: Close-up on Leo's hand clutching the headset cord. His knuckles are white. The green plastic dinosaur is visible, half-fallen from his shirt pocket.
motion: His grip tightens, the cord digging into his palm.

text: You whispered it again three months ago, your mouth against her ear, after her breathing stopped.
picture: Another memory insert, full screen: Leo in a hospice room, his face pressed against the ear of a still Ana in a bed. His eyes are squeezed shut. The room is bare except for the bed.
motion: A single, shaking breath from Leo.

text: You did not speak it aloud again. Now she is saying it back wrong.
picture: Back to present. Leo is now standing, pushing his chair back. He still holds the headset, dangling at his side. He stares at the dark phone screen, his expression hollow.
motion: The headset cord swings slowly like a pendulum.

text: Mira is shaking. She tells you about her mother in Curaçao.
picture: Wide two-shot. Mira stands a few feet from Leo's cubicle, hugging herself tightly. She is talking rapidly. Leo stands facing her, but his head is turned, staring blankly at the now-dark phone on his desk.
motion: Mira's hands gesture as she speaks.

text: How she stays up late when Mira works nights.
picture: On Mira, in profile. Her expression is worried but warm. She gestures toward a wall clock, implying late hours.
motion: She glances at the clock, then back to Leo.

text: How she makes soup when she is worried. You catch yourself smiling.
picture: Close-up on Leo's face. A tiny, broken smile touches his lips for a fraction of a second. His eyes are still distant, but they briefly meet Mira's.
motion: The faint smile appears and fades.

text: Almost laughing. 'My mother-in-law does the same,' you say. 'Caldo verde.
picture: Two-shot from behind Leo's shoulder. We see the back of his head and Mira's full, reacting face. She has stopped hugging herself, her hands now open in a gesture of shared understanding. The blinking red light of the phone is reflected clearly in her widened, worried eyes.
motion: Mira's eyes shift slightly, catching the red reflection.

text: You cannot find real kale here.' You spoke of Ana in the present tense.
picture: Extreme close-up on Leo's hands, fingers frantic. The green plastic dinosaur spins fast in the space between his thumb and forefinger, a blur of dark green against black. Nothing else is in frame.
motion: The green plastic dinosaur spins rapidly between Leo's fingers.
sound: the faint plastic whir of a toy spinning

text: To a stranger. Something moves in your chest.
picture: Insert shot focusing on Leo's chest area. His collared shirt is wrinkled. A slight, unnatural bulge pushes outward against the fabric near his sternum, as if something inside is shifting.
motion: The fabric of Leo's shirt bulges subtly, then settles.

text: You roll the dinosaur faster between your fingers. You do not say her name.
picture: Leo sits at his desk, head bowed. His shoulders are hunched tight. One hand rests on the desk, clenched into a fist. The other hand, just below frame, is implied to be spinning the dinosaur. The empty chair of extension 704 is visible in the background, deep in shadow.
motion: Leo's head remains bowed, unmoving.

text: You have not said it in three months.
picture: Close-up on Leo's face in profile, lit by the cold monitor light. His eyes are squeezed shut. His lips are pressed into a thin, tight line, holding back the name.
motion: Leo's eyelids tremble slightly.

text: You run for the elevator. Not the stairs, the stairs lead past Floor 7, and
picture: Wide shot of the call center floor at night, most cubicles dark. Leo is a small, panicked figure sprinting from left to right across the frame towards a set of distant elevator doors. His body is angled forward, one arm outstretched.
motion: Leo runs desperately across the floor.
sound: the slap of shoes on linoleum, distant and echoing

text: you cannot pass that door again, not after last time.
picture: Insert shot of a dark stairwell door, a small rectangular window set into it. The word 'EXIT' glows faintly green above it. The door is at the far left edge of the frame, ominous.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: The elevator is faster. The elevator is always faster.
picture: Leo inside the elevator. He faces the control panel, his back to us. His hand stabs repeatedly at a button. The floor indicator above the doors is a row of dark circles except one glowing '7'. His shoulders are tense.
motion: Leo's finger jabs the button again and again.
sound: the repeated, muted *thump* of a plastic button being pressed

text: But the elevator stops at seven.
picture: Close-up on the elevator's floor indicator. The backlit number '7' glows with a sickly yellow light. A small, sharp 'ding' sound is implied. The frame trembles as the elevator stops.
motion: The glowing '7' holds steady as the car jerks to a halt.

text: The doors open on darkness. No lights.
picture: From inside the elevator, looking out. The doors are fully open. Beyond is pure, featureless blackness. Leo is a stark white silhouette frozen in the doorway, backlit by the elevator's ceiling light. He faces the darkness.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: No alarm. Just the smell of burned plastic and something else, something warm.
picture: Leo stands frozen in profile at the threshold. His head is tilted slightly, nostrils flared. One hand grips the elevator door frame. The vast blackness of Floor 7 occupies the right two-thirds of the frame.
motion: Leo's hand grips the door frame tighter.

text: The doors try to close. You press the button for the garage.
picture: Insert shot of Leo's finger pressing the 'G' button on the elevator panel. The button lights up. The '7' button's light is now off.
motion: The 'G' button lights up under Leo's finger.
sound: the soft click of the button

text: The car sinks down. In the polished steel, you see your reflection,
picture: Inside the descending elevator. Leo faces the brushed steel wall, his own pale reflection clear. He stares ahead, exhausted. A second, identical reflection (Hollow) stands unnaturally close beside his, its head tilted in sorrow, its face a mask of deep grief. Only the two figures are visible in the reflective surface.
motion: The reflections of Leo and Hollow hold still as the elevator descends.
sound: the low hum of elevator machinery

text: and beside it, a second shape, holding something red.
picture: Extreme close-up on the reflection of Hollow's hand in the steel. It holds the dinosaur, but it is now painted a chipped, bloody red. The toy is held delicately, as if it's something precious and terrible. Leo's own empty hand reflection is just at the edge of the frame.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: You blink. It's gone. The doors open on the parking garage.
picture: Wide shot from outside the elevator in the parking garage. The doors are open, revealing Leo standing rigid inside, facing out. The garage is dimly lit by sparse overhead lights. He is a figure of stunned shock.
motion: The elevator doors remain open.
sound: the distant drip of water in the garage

text: You drive across the city, the road slick with rain, the red
picture: From the passenger seat of a car. Leo drives, his face grim in the dashboard's green glow. Rain streaks horizontally across the windshield. His eyes are fixed on the road ahead, lit by headlights.
motion: Raindrops streak diagonally across the windshield.
sound: the steady swish of windshield wipers

text: shape glowing in your mind's eye like a taillight you cannot catch.
picture: Superimposed over a blurred, rain-streaked view of the road: a faint, glowing outline of the red dinosaur. It hovers in the center of Leo's field of vision like an afterimage, pulsing softly. Leo's tired eyes are visible in the rearview mirror at the bottom left of the frame, staring at it.
motion: The ghostly red dinosaur shape flickers faintly.

text: Ana's sister's house is dark. You let yourself in.
picture: An empty, modern hospice bed sits in the centre of a dark living room, its crisp white sheets glowing under a single streetlight's beam through a window. The room's other furniture is consumed by deep shadow.
motion: Dust motes drift through the beam of streetlight.
sound: the faint hum of a refrigerator

text: The hospice bed in the living room is empty. Your sister-in-law sleeps on the couch, breathing slow.
picture: A woman sleeps curled on a couch in the foreground, her back to us. In the blurred background, the empty hospice bed is a stark white rectangle against the dark living room wall.
motion: The sleeping woman's shoulder rises and falls in slow, deep sleep.

text: You run your hand over the counter. Your fingers find dust on the newspapers.
picture: Leo's hand, fingers slightly spread, drags through a thick layer of pale grey dust on a dark kitchen counter. The green dinosaur is a bright accent in his other hand, held limply at his side.
motion: His fingers leave clean trails in the dust.
sound: the soft scritch of fingers on dust

text: The top one is dated three months ago. The week she stopped breathing.
picture: An extreme close-up on a newspaper headline. The date is a stark black mark on the pale paper. The rest of the text is an unreadable blur of chalk lines.
motion: Nothing moves. The date is stark and still.

text: The soup pot sits in the drying rack, bone-dry, a crack running from rim to base.
picture: A cracked ceramic soup pot sits on a wire dish rack. The crack is a jagged dark line running from the pale rim down to the dark base. The pot's interior is bone-dry.
motion: The camera pans slowly along the length of the crack.

text: You did not smell caldo verde in this house. You smelled it through the phone.
picture: Leo stands frozen in the dark kitchen, his shoulders slumped. He stares absently at the dried soup pot on the counter. The green dinosaur hangs loosely from his fingers.
motion: He is perfectly still, a statue of realization.

text: The phone that rang from a floor that has been dark since February.
picture: Leo stands in the centre of Ana's dark bedroom. He is a dark silhouette against the smooth, hospital-cornered sheets of her empty bed, which glows faintly in the moonlight.
motion: He stands motionless, looking at the bed.
sound: the faint, lonely chirp of a single cricket

text: You stand in Ana's room. The sheets are smooth.
picture: A hand's-eye view: Leo's hand hovers just above the taut, smooth surface of the bed's white sheet. His fingers do not touch it.
motion: His hand trembles slightly before pulling back.

text: Cold. You pull out your phone.
picture: Leo sits on the edge of the bed. He hunches forward, elbows on his knees, staring down at his phone's screen as its blue light illuminates his tired face from below.
motion: His thumb swipes slowly across the phone's screen.
sound: the faint digital tap of a touchscreen

text: The voicemail is still saved under Don't Delete.
picture: An extreme close-up on the phone screen. It displays a saved voicemail labelled 'Don't Delete'. The red 'play' triangle is prominent on the white list background.
motion: A single, final tap lands on the red play icon.

text: You play it one last time.
picture: Close on Leo's face in the dark room. His eyes are squeezed shut. A single tear carves a clean white line down his chalk cheek.
motion: The tear slowly tracks down his face.
sound: Ana's recorded voice, slightly tinny: 'Hi, love. I'm on my way.'

text: Hi, love. I'm on my way.
picture: A stark close-up on Leo's ear and the side of his head. The phone is a white block pressed tightly against it. His expression is one of painful, concentrated listening.
motion: His jaw muscles clench and relax.
sound: the faint recorded hiss of the voicemail line

text: And after the beep, very close to the phone, closer than you ever noticed: a second voice.
picture: Leo sits on the dark bed, phone still to his ear, but his head is now tilted, listening intently. His expression has shifted from grief to dawning, horrified comprehension.
motion: His eyes slowly widen.
sound: The recorded, slow, rhythmic sound of breathing, louder and clearer than the voice.

text: Breathing. Slower than yours.
picture: A wide shot from behind Leo. He is a small, hunched figure on the edge of the empty, glowing bed in the vast, dark room. The green dinosaur has fallen from his hand onto the floor.
motion: He remains utterly still, a frozen monument to understanding.
sound: The breathing sound fades into absolute silence.

text: The sheets on the hospice bed have never been slept in.
picture: Leo stands with his back to us in the foreground, facing a pristine hospice bed. The sheets are white and smooth, unslept in. A simple nightstand and a square wall mirror are in the background.
motion: Leo's shoulders slump slightly.

text: The room is cold. You turn from the empty bed and your reflection does not move.
picture: Leo has turned away from the bed, looking back toward the room's door, his face weary. In the wall mirror, his reflection remains facing the bed, its back turned to the real Leo.
motion: Leo's head turns away from the bed.

text: It stays facing the bed, shoulders curved, hand in pocket.
picture: A close-up on the mirror from inside Ana's room, showing the Hollow's back and its hand resting in its pocket, as it stares at the empty bed.
motion: The Hollow's head stays perfectly still.

text: You step closer. The hallway stretches long and dark.
picture: Leo is a small figure in a long, dark hallway, advancing left to right toward a full-length mirror at the far end. The walls are featureless and recede into darkness.
motion: Leo walks slowly left to right.

text: And in the mirror at the end, something waits.
picture: We are now looking at the hallway mirror from Leo's perspective. The Hollow stands in the mirror, full-body, a dark silhouette waiting.
motion: The Hollow does not move.

text: It looks exactly like you.
picture: Leo's face in sharp foreground profile, looking rightwards, his expression tired. Blurred behind him in the mirror, the Hollow's face stares back, identical.
motion: Leo's eyes widen slightly.

text: Same dark hair. Same lines around the eyes from too many night shifts.
picture: An insert shot of the Hollow's face in the mirror. We see the details: the dark hair, the lines of exhaustion around its sorrowful eyes.
motion: A single tear wells in the Hollow's eye.

text: But the face is three months younger.
picture: An extreme close-up on the Hollow's eye and cheek in the mirror. The skin looks slightly fuller, the expression less worn. The difference is subtle but wrong.
motion: The tear begins to trail down the cheek.

text: The face that stopped going home. In its hand: the dinosaur.
picture: Back to a wider shot of the mirror. The Hollow's face is streaked with tears. It is holding up the red plastic dinosaur toward the glass.
motion: The Hollow raises the red dinosaur.

text: Green plastic, but red now, painted in the lantern-light.
picture: Insert on the dinosaur. It is the familiar green plastic shape, but coated in a chipped, bloody red paint. It glints in the imagined light from off-screen.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: You left yours in your pocket that night. You have been carrying nothing since.
picture: Leo, standing before the mirror, feels at his empty shirt pocket. His reflection, the Hollow, holds the red dinosaur at its side. They are opposites.
motion: Leo's hand pats his empty pocket.

text: It speaks. Your voice, from your own throat, in the glass.
picture: A side view, Leo facing the mirror. His mouth is closed. In the mirror, the Hollow's mouth is open, speaking silently. Its expression is one of devastating sorrow.
motion: The Hollow's lips move in a silent, desperate sentence.

text: 'I'll be there when you wake.' You understand then.
picture: Leo's face in extreme close-up, his tired eyes wide. A single point of red is reflected in his irises from the blinking phone light down the hall. His mouth is slightly open, understanding dawning.
motion: His pupils dilate.

text: The threshold law. You invited it.
picture: Leo, hunched and frozen, looking over his shoulder at Ana's closed door behind him. His shadow, elongated by the unseen hall light, points directly at the door's threshold.
motion: A slow pan from Leo's face to the closed door.

text: You pursued it across the city. You ran toward instead of away.
picture: A memory silhouette: Leo's stick figure runs left to right across a cityscape of simple white chalk towers. The red dinosaur in his hand is a blur of motion.
motion: Leo's figure races across the frame from right to left.

text: The hollow is not Ana's ghost. The hollow is yours.
picture: Leo turns fully to face the audience, his expression hollowed. Behind him, in a dark mirror, the Hollow stands perfectly still, its face a mask of sorrow.
motion: The camera pulls back to reveal the Hollow in the mirror.

text: You stand in the hallway. The mirror shows two of you.
picture: Leo stands in the center of the hallway, phone clutched in one hand. In the mirror on the wall, the Hollow stands in an identical pose, holding the red dinosaur. The door to Ana's room occupies the space between real Leo and reflected Hollow.
motion: The phone's dark screen reflects a faint, upside-down version of the blinking red light from down the hall.

text: One holding the red dinosaur.
picture: Close-up on the Hollow's hand in the mirror, its fingers curled tightly around the red plastic dinosaur.
motion: The dinosaur's red paint catches the faint light.

text: One holding a phone, its screen dark, the saved voicemail a weight in his palm.
picture: Close-up on Leo's hand holding the dark phone. His palm is upturned, as if feeling the weight of the saved voicemail. His other hand hangs empty at his side.
motion: A slow tilt up from his hand to his resigned face.

text: Between you: the door to Ana's room.
picture: The door of Ana's room is in sharp focus, centered. Leo and the mirror-Hollow are blurred shapes on either side in the background, both facing the door.
motion: Nothing moves; the door is perfectly still.

text: Threshold. You have not crossed it in three months.
picture: Extreme close-up on the doorknob. A faint layer of dust coats its surface.
motion: A very slow push-in on the untouched doorknob.

text: You have not said her name. The hollow waits.
picture: Leo seen from behind, his head bowed. In the mirror ahead, the Hollow waits, its head tilted, watching Leo's back. The hallway seems to stretch endlessly into darkness behind them.
motion: The shot pulls out slowly, emphasizing their isolation.

text: It will not move until you speak.
picture: Profile of Leo, his lips pressed together. The Hollow's reflection is just visible at the edge of the frame, perfectly still, waiting.
motion: A single muscle twitches in Leo's jaw.

text: The kettle clicks off somewhere far below. The silence after is the sound of your own breathing.
picture: Leo's face, relaxed. His eyes are closed. He is taking a deep, slow breath, his chest rising.
motion: His chest rises and falls once, slowly.

text: Slower now. Steady at last.
picture: Leo, eyes still closed, shoulders dropping from their perpetual hunch. His hands hang loose at his sides.
motion: A slow tilt down his body as tension drains away.

text: You speak her name. Ana.
picture: Extreme close-up on Leo's mouth as it opens to speak. The faint, chalky white outline of the word 'ANA' forms in the air before his lips and begins to fade.
motion: The word forms and immediately starts to dissipate.

text: The word breaks something open. The hollow does not vanish.
picture: Leo standing firm. In the mirror, the Hollow shudders but holds its ground. It does not fade. Its posture collapses inward slightly.
motion: A pan from Leo to his reflection as it shudders.

text: It weeps. Your face weeping the tears you would not shed.
picture: Tears, drawn as thick white lines, stream down the Hollow's sorrowful face in the mirror. In the foreground, Leo's real face remains dry, but his expression mirrors the same profound grief.
motion: Tears roll down the Hollow's chalk-white cheeks.

text: You step forward. You take the red dinosaur from its hand.
picture: Close on Leo's chalk-white hand entering the mirror surface, which ripples like dark water. His hand closes around the red plastic dinosaur held by his reflection's identical, sorrowful hand.
motion: Leo's hand slowly closes around the red dinosaur.

text: You hold it to your chest, the plastic pressing into your sternum like a heartbeat.
picture: Medium shot from the side. Leo stands hunched before the mirror, holding the red dinosaur pressed against his chest. His reflection watches, its empty hand still outstretched.
motion: The red dinosaur presses into his shirt, a subtle dent forming.

text: You step into Ana's room. The bed is empty.
picture: Wide shot from the doorway. Leo, shoulders slumped, stands in the frame looking at an empty bed stark against the dark room. A simple nightstand holds a lamp.
motion: Leo stands frozen in the doorway.

text: The bed has always been empty. You lie down where she lay.
picture: Low-angle medium shot. Leo walks into the room, his body heavy, and lies down on the empty bed, his head sinking into the pillow.
motion: His body settles onto the mattress.

text: The sheets are cold. You close your eyes.
picture: Close-up on Leo's face on the pillow, eyes closed. The red dinosaur is a faint red blur held near his chest.
motion: His eyelids close slowly.

text: Your fingers, curled around the red dinosaur, go slack.
picture: Extreme close-up insert on Leo's chalk-white hand on the dark sheets. His fingers are tightly curled around the red dinosaur. They slowly relax, one by one, until the dinosaur rests loosely in his open palm.
motion: The fingers slowly uncurl, releasing tension.

text: The last thing you feel is not the cold, but the warmth of the plastic,
picture: Medium shot from above. Leo lies on the bed, body slack in sleep. A subtle, warm chalk glow emanates faintly from the red dinosaur in his open hand.
motion: The gentle glow pulses once.

text: as if it has been held in a closed hand for a very long time.
picture: Close-up on Leo's sleeping, serene face. The red dinosaur lies on the pillow beside his cheek, the source of the soft, warm glow. The accent red is the dinosaur.
motion: A single, slow breath mists faintly near his lips.

text: You will keep your promise at last. I'll be there when you wake.
picture: Wide shot from the foot of the bed. Leo sleeps peacefully. The red dinosaur rests on the pillow, glowing softly, a small spot of warmth in the cold, dark room.
motion: The glow of the dinosaur holds steady.

text: There is a voicemail saved under 'Don't Delete' on your phone right now.
picture: Medium shot. The Storyteller stands in the void, holding their lantern lower. They look directly at the viewer, face drawn in shadow except for the light of the lantern's red flame. The accent red is the flame.
motion: The Storyteller's head tilts slightly.

text: You know the one. The voice you have not let yourself hear.
picture: Close-up on the Storyteller's face. Their expression is intent, challenging. The red flame of the lantern flickers in their eyes.
motion: The red flame flickers.

text: Listen tonight. Or don't.
picture: Medium shot, slightly low angle. The Storyteller gestures slowly with their free hand, palm open, as if offering or questioning. The void behind them is absolute.
motion: Their hand opens in a deliberate gesture.

text: But ask yourself: whose voice has been waiting on the line you never answer?
picture: Wide shot. The Storyteller stands alone in the dark void, lantern held at their side. The small red flame is the only point of light, a tiny, distant beacon. The accent red is the flame.
motion: The lantern's red flame shrinks slightly as the void expands.
